settings.the_text:
Cruise into flow state

Get in the zone and stay there. Lion’s Mane and Cordyceps pair up as the ultimate treat for your brain — elevating cognitive function, sharpening memory, and supercharging your focus for long-lasting productivity.

Feel grounded and centered

Reishi and Sun Mushroom’s adaptogenic properties help your body and mind find their way back to balance during times of stress. Look forward to brighter, calmer, and more peaceful days ahead.

Healthy gut, healthy you

A balanced gut microbiome is the backbone of good health. That’s why Mushroom Golden Blend calls upon Chaga, Trumpet King, and Maitake to deliver a targeted blend of gut-balancing compounds, including antioxidants, polysaccharides, and prebiotics.

Optimize your immune health

The concentrated shot of beta-glucans from the addition of Antrodia, Shiitake, and Turkey Tail further bolsters your natural immune defenses and enhances all-round well-being. Feel your best every day.

Forget endless tubs of supplements and powders. Mushroom Golden Blend condenses the ancient, health-boosting benefits of 10 functional mushrooms into 2 easy-to-take capsules. Whether you need energy, sharper concentration, a little more chill, or an immune boost, Mushroom Golden Blend’s got you covered.

Our blend includes both the fruiting body of the mushroom, which is the part you can see above ground, and the mycelium, which is like the roots of a mushroom. This means you benefit from the full spectrum of bioactive compounds naturally found in all 10 functional mushrooms, from antioxidants to prebiotics and polysaccharides to beta-glucans — as nature intended.

Mushroom Golden Blend is a long-term solution for enhanced cognition, energy, stress management, and well-being. When consistently incorporated into a daily routine, the mushrooms’ nutrients compound in your body and become more effective. You’ll typically feel a boost in focus, energy, and clarity within 30 minutes, but expect the most noticeable impacts after 30 days of consistent supplementation.

Mushroom Golden Blend is USDA-certified organic and non-GMO. In other words, you can be confident that it’s free of toxins, pesticides, herbicides, and chemicals that can harm your body and the environment. Speaking of protecting the environment, the controlled growing conditions of our organic mushrooms produce very low organic waste, low levels of carbon dioxide gas, plus involve both low water and energy usage.

Like all our products, Mushroom Golden Blend is rigorously lab and third-party-tested. This includes complete microbial testing for any bacteria, yeast, and mold; heavy metals testing; pesticide testing; and testing for purity and active compounds. But you shouldn’t just take our word for it. Because we believe in full transparency, we publish our lab results (i.e., Certificate of Analysis or CoA) on our website. Go ahead, check it out for yourself.

Known for its brain-boosting power, Lion’s Mane supports memory, focus, and mental clarity. It promotes the production of Nerve Growth Factor (NGF), essential for nerve health and cognitive function. Additionally, it enhances neurite outgrowth, helping to slow or even reverse brain cell degeneration. It also provides antioxidant support, protecting brain cells from daily stress.*

Known as the “mushroom of immortality”, Reishi is a revered adaptogen that may help reduce occasional stress and balance immune function. Rich in beta-glucans and triterpenoids, it supports immunity, healthy blood sugar, and heart health. Reishi has a long history in traditional medicine for enhancing vitality and longevity.*

With a rich profile of polysaccharides, Turkey Tail is one of the most researched mushrooms for immune health. It acts as a powerful immune booster and supports a balanced gut microbiome, which further strengthens immunity.*

“King of medicinal mushrooms”, known for its high antioxidant content, Chaga protects cells from oxidative stress and supports immune health. It also promotes skin health and youthful appearance, helping to fight free radicals that contribute to aging.*

Cordyceps enhances energy, stamina, and athletic performance by supporting oxygen flow and ATP production. It is also known to promote heart health and respiratory function, making it a favorite among athletes and active individuals.*

Shiitake is packed with essential nutrients like vitamins B and D, supporting immunity and cardiovascular health. Known for promoting healthy cholesterol levels, Shiitake also provides natural energy support, contributing to overall wellness.*

Maitake supports cardiovascular health by regulating cholesterol and blood sugar levels. This nutrient-rich mushroom is high in beta-glucans, which enhance immune function and contribute to metabolic health.*

Unique to Taiwan, Antrodia Camphorata is highly valued for its immune-enhancing and liver-supporting properties. It provides antioxidant protection, helps fight fatigue, and has been used in traditional medicine to support overall vitality.*

Royal Sun Mushroom helps balance hormones, supports immune health, and aids liver function. It also assists in managing blood sugar levels, promoting heart health, and maintaining a balanced metabolic profile.*
High in the master antioxidant L-Ergothioneine, King Trumpet supports heart and bone health. It is known to help regulate cholesterol levels, boost immunity, and enhance overall vitality.*
